name: mem_profile
description: Say what a memory container actually is before anything is run against it: crash dump, hibernation file, LiME or AVML capture, ELF core, or flat physical memory — with the header fields, the physical memory runs where the format lists them, and what the bytes suggest about the operating system.

path.description: The memory image, dump or hibernation file

scan_mb.description: How many megabytes to sample for operating-system hints (default 64)
